content: The Iʿtiqādāt is a lengthy treatise that Melvin-Koushki says was written during Ibn Turka's second trip to Herat to clear his name of accusations of deviation from the Sunna and pro-Sufi bias; it presents the author as a staunch Sunni-Ashʿarī opposed to Muʿtazilism, philosophy, Shiʿism and all forms of messianic Sufism, taking as its theme Q 11:54.
